signOutSplitReview.model: Discovery.tla splits SignOut into SignOutStart (close, credential provenance kept), SignOutFail (no change) and SignOut (committed revocation or expiry). CredentialChanged cannot start during sign-out. New broken variant signout-start-clear must violate ClosedIsEmpty.
signOutSplitReview.review: Since 7d947f91: signOut calls closeDiscovery and keeps the epoch until a 204 revocation reply; failed or cancelled sign-out reconnects; Show and write busy cleanup is epoch-owned; checkServerContract rethrows CancellationError on epoch change; followChanges retries discovery from Offline on ready, mapped to Retry; Attachment, batch-edit and Series loading are released at replacement. No publication guard, Show acceptance or identity check is weakened.
signOutSplitReview.housekeeping: prepare-inputs compiles leave .bun-build temporaries in the new .scratch/bin cache; they were moved out of the checkout after lsof showed no holder, so check-swift could run its temporary guard. No file was deleted.

messageOwnershipReview.review: message gains an owner (general, connection, signOut); ready and successful writes clear only named owners; a credential or Profile change ends a sign-out notice; the saved signOutNotice restore is removed. restore and signIn use stillOwns(epoch) after each await: a superseded epoch returns without touching state, a cancelled same-epoch task throws to the existing cancellation cleanup. Discovery publication, Show acceptance, closeDiscovery at sign-out start and every epoch comparison are unchanged.

messageRuleReview.review: Messages carry a kind, a growing sequence and an optional raising surface; successes clear only their kinds and only messages older than their start; credential, Profile and Snapshot reload end any message; closing the picker, Import or Delete dialog ends its message. In Discovery, applyDiscoveryShow notes a mark after closeDiscovery and on success clears only an older discoveryShow message; its failure publishes kind discoveryShow to the main window. No discovery publication, Show acceptance, canShowDiscovery, closeDiscovery or epoch check changed.
